segments.t: 浮光，Lemaire发表于1845年 引自：ICN 图片：ICN & Flickr Synonyms\异名: Cotyledon fulgens  (Lemaire) Baker (1869) Echeveria retusa  Lindley (1847) / Cotyledon retusa  (Lindley) Baker (1869) Series Gibbiflorae\粉彩莲系 Distribution : Mexico (México, Morelos, Guerrero, Jalisco, Michoacán, Oaxaca, Veracruz). 分布：墨西哥（墨西哥，莫雷洛斯州，格雷罗州，哈利斯科州，米却肯州，瓦哈卡州，韦拉克鲁斯）。 Two varieties : 该种有两个变种: Echeveria fulgens var. fulgens 浮光 - 浮光变种 Echeveria fulgens var. obtusifolia  (Rose) Kimnach, 1998 浮光 - 大青叶变种 FULGENS VAR. FULGENS (engl./ fr.) 浮光 - 浮光变种 Description (according to E. Walther, Echeveria, 1972, p. 159) : 描述（根据Walther 1972年出版的《拟石莲花》，159页） Stem evident, short, or to 30 cm long, mostly simple. 茎干：有些植株较短，也有或可长至30厘米，茎干明显而干净。 Leaves rosulate, comparatively few, always more or less glaucous, obovate-spathulate, 8 – 15 cm long, 4 – 7 cm broad, obtuse or retuse, mucronate, above concave,cress-green, margins often undulate-lacerate, often indian-red, 15 - 25 mm wide at the petiole-like base. 莲座：由叶片构成、密度较稀疏；叶面或多或少覆有些白霜，叶形由倒卵延伸至匙形， 8 - 16厘米长， 4 - 7厘米宽，上表面呈钝圆微凹，叶端具短尖；叶色呈水芹绿，边缘经常波荡起伏，叶缘常现一抹印度红；叶柄基部 15 - 25毫米宽。 Inflorescences two or more, erect or laxly spreading, to 90 cm tall, but often much less; peduncle stout or slender, Corinthian-red; lower bracts numerous, broad, obovate, truncate to acutish, to 35 mm long, ascending, colour as the leaves; branches two or three, secund-racemose, stiffly spreading or laxly spreading to decumbent, each with 12 or more flowers; pedicels stout or slender, 2 – 6 mm long. 花序：圆锥花序顶生，数量为两个或多个；整体向上稀松直立展开，高可至90厘米但通常远不足这个高度；花梗粗壮或​​细长花梗，呈科林斯红色；下苞片数目若干，较宽，倒卵形，边缘分明，长至35毫米，形态向上，与叶片同色；总状花序，向单侧长出两到三个分支， 较为僵直地延伸，也有部分植株的花序松散蔓延到低处；每个分支可开出12个或更多的花；粗壮或​​花梗纤细， 2 - 6毫米长。 Flowers: Sepals unequal, deltoid to linear-lanceolate, acute to shortly acuminate, longest to 10 mm long, ascending-spreading, celandine-green with bloom; corolla broadly urceolate to narrowly conoid-campanulate, to 15 mm long, to 11 mm in basal diameter, less than 8 mm at mouth, peach-red; petals slightly spreading at tips, with pronounced basal cavity within, sometimes with an appendage; inside pale orange-yellow at base, above xanthine-orange. 花：萼片非水平，三角形至线状披针形，锐尖至略微渐尖，最长至10毫米长，向上翻翘，色为白屈菜绿；花冠宽壶状至狭圆锥钟状，15毫米长，11毫米底径，口径小于8毫米，桃红色；花瓣尖端稍展开，花体空腔明显；有时带附生物；花壁内侧：基部苍白至橙黄，顶部花黄橙色。 Cytology : n = 27, 162 染色体：n=27, 162
Photo from Favourite flowers of garden and greenhouse London and New York :Frederick Warne & co.,1896-97..

Photo by Zusung@Flickr FULGENS VAR. OBTUSIFOLIA (Rose) Kimnach, 1998 浮光 - 大青叶变种 Synonyms 异名 : Echeveria obtusifolia  Rose (1903) Echeveria scopulorum  Rose (1905) / E. obtusifolia var. scopulorum  (Rose) von Poellnitz (1936) Distribution : Mexico (Morelos, Michoacán) 分布：墨西哥（莫雷洛斯州，米却肯州） Differs from var. fulgens  by its obovate-cuneate leaves which are only 4 – 8 cm long and green (though often with red margin). 此变种以青绿色、大型的圆钝叶(仅4~8厘米长) 区别于浮光变种；叶缘经常有红边 Cytology : n = 27, 135, 162 染色体 = 27, 135, 162

Photos Bernie DeChant (注：该原始种为多个著名杂交品种如‘Fred Wass’、'Florence' 等的亲本，长期未引荐入国内，故借其拉丁种名fulgen - "光芒辐射"之意，并遵循其发音，暂拟中文名 “浮光”，请大家提意见) 以下为交配种 Clarence Wright E. fulgens var. obtusifolia x E. fimbriata. Created by Dick Wright, De Luz, California, USA, named after his father. Rosettes up to 20 cm in diameter. The colour of leaves of this hybrid may vary considerably seasonally and is often dependent on cultural conditions. They are of bronze-red tonings, fading to greener colours on occasions. The leaves are long and narrow, almost twisted in appearance, and have undulating margins which tend to curve upwards and inwards. 浮光大青叶 x E. fimbriata交配种，由Dick Wright大神在加州培育而成，以其父之名命名。莲座直径可达20厘米。此种叶色随季节性改变非常显著，并常受培育环境影响而变化。叶色为紫铜色基调，某些情况下会褪变为偏绿的色泽。叶形狭长，多数翻卷，并有波浪起伏的叶缘。 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=2733&file_version=5&lw=is.jpeg http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=475&file_version=5&lw=is.jpeg http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=1138&file_version=5&lw=is.jpeg http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=477&file_version=5&lw=is.jpeg Tori Named by E. Aubé in memory of Victoria Stafford. Origin and parentage unknown. In Australia this plant is distributed as "E. obtusifolia" or "E. fulgens var. obtusifolia". However it is not this species but a hybrid and it is even doubtful that E. fulgens var. obtusifolia is one of the parents. “Tori”由Aubé命名，以纪念被残忍奸杀的8岁女孩Victoria Stafford（案件问度娘），亲本不明。Tori以“拟石莲属大青叶”或“浮光大青叶”的名字在澳大利亚广泛引种 — 但Tori实为交配种，且仅是亲本疑似为浮光大青叶。 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=369&file_version=3 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=370&file_version=3 Photos Emmanuelle Aubé Green Narae Distributed in Korea as a hybrid of Echeveria pallida, which most certainly it is not. It may rather be a hybrid with E. fulgens. Green Narae以“霜之鹤交配种”的身份在韩国的广为引种。可以肯定的是亲本搞错了，它应是浮光的后代。 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=1229&file_version=3 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=1231&file_version=3 Gabrielle E. gibbiflora (Ajusio, District Federal)  x E. fulgens var. obtusifolia （Created by Jean-Michel Moullec, 2007） http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=1121&file_version=3 Metalgen 'Fred Wass' Parentage / Parenté : E. gibbiflora 'Metallica' x E. fulgens Named by /nommé par Brian Fearn of Abbey Brook Cactus Nursery, UK http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=5490&file_version=3 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=5491&file_version=3 http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=5492&file_version=3 Florence Echeveria gibbiflora (Ajusio, District Federal) x E. fulgens v. obtusifolia Created by Jean-Michel Moullec (2006) and named after his daughter. http://www.crassulaceae.ch/download.php?file_id=1094&file_version=5&lw=is.jpeg
